summary: The enclosure is visually coherent and several intended component envelopes and routes are shown, but the rendered views do not directly establish all fit, retention, access, airflow, clearance, and exact-envelope requirements; those checks remain not verified.

checks.description: The assembly reads as a coherent upright enclosure with aligned frame, panels, tray, internal fit bodies, and feet; no obvious floating fragment or gross collision is visible in the cited overview.

evidence.description: Focused isometric overview visibly shows a complete, proportionate vertical case assembly.

checks.description: The views suggest a motherboard-side internal region, but do not directly prove the 170 x 170 mm mounting pattern, retention, or accessible rear I/O.

evidence.description: Front view shows the enclosure but does not expose sufficient mounting-interface detail.

checks.description: A ventilated side is visible, but the image does not directly establish the AXP120-X67 envelope or a measurable intake gap to the side panel.

evidence.description: Isometric view shows extensive side ventilation, while the cooler-to-panel clearance remains visually unresolved.

checks.description: The images do not directly establish all rear GPU retention, I/O bracket engagement, riser connectivity, and power-cable bend clearance requirements.

evidence.description: Overall isometric view does not expose enough rear-side interface detail to verify the complete GPU installation path.

checks.description: The rendered evidence does not directly prove the specified 160 x 80 x 40 mm PSU fit together with retention, AC-inlet access, airflow, and cable routing.

evidence.description: Front view cannot directly establish the rear PSU interfaces and retention details.

checks.description: An enclosure control feature is suggested, but the general views do not directly establish both external actuation and an uninterrupted internal path to the motherboard header.

evidence.description: Front view provides insufficient detail to prove the complete external-to-internal button interface.

checks.description: The focused rear assembly view visibly distinguishes the motherboard/cooler side from the rear GPU and lower PSU arrangement around the tray.

evidence.description: Focused rear isometric view shows the intended stacked rear-side component layout relative to the central tray.

checks.description: The focused rear views visibly show the installed GPU envelope associated with its rear mount, riser passage, and reserved power-bend volume.

evidence.description: Rear isometric focus visibly groups the GPU body, mount, riser slot, and clearance envelope.

checks.description: The focused rear views visibly show the PSU seated in a separate lower cradle with adjacent harness-routing and cable-guide geometry.

evidence.description: Rear isometric focus shows the lower PSU envelope, its cradle, and neighboring cable-routing provisions.

checks.description: The model visibly presents as a complete upright ITX case with structural frame, two vented sides, feet, control, tray, GPU mount, and PSU cradle, without obvious floating debris.

evidence.description: Focused isometric assembly view shows the principal enclosure structures as a coherent case.

checks.description: The focused views visibly show the front power-button object and a modeled internal route extending toward the motherboard-tray region.

evidence.description: Focused isometric view makes the button and its internal route toward the tray visible together.

checks.description: The enclosure appears consistent with a roughly 4.67 L upright form and no sub-4 L claim is visible, but the exact 120 x 190 x 205 mm dimensions and calculated volume are not directly established by the images.
